question: Yashodhara Dalmia is the author of which famous book?

options.text: The Painted World of the Warlis

solution:
The Correct answer is __**The Painted World of the Warlis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Yashodhara Dalmia** is a renowned art historian and writer known for her extensive work on Indian art.
 
• **The Painted World of the Warlis** is her famous book that explores the **tribal art** of the **Warli community**, an indigenous group from the state of **Maharashtra, India**.
 
• The book provides a detailed insight into the **Warli painting tradition**,
